site.name: PDF Worker
site.tagline: Free PDF tools that run in your browser

tools.name: Merge PDF
tools.title: Merge PDF – Combine PDF files free, online and private
tools.description: Combine PDFs and images into one PDF in the order you want. Free, no sign-up, and your files never leave your device.
tools.intro: Join several PDFs – and JPG or PNG images – into a single document. Drag the files into order before merging.
steps: Select or drop your PDF and image files.
Drag the cards into the order you want.
Click Merge PDF and download the combined file.
faq: Can I merge images with PDFs?
Yes. Images become pages in the merged PDF, in the position you place them.
Is there a limit on files or size?
No fixed limit. Everything runs on your device, so very large jobs depend on your device's memory.

tools.name: Split PDF
tools.title: Split PDF – Separate PDF pages into files, free and private
tools.description: Split a PDF every few pages or by custom ranges like 1-3, 4-8. Get all parts in one ZIP. Runs in your browser, no upload.
tools.intro: Break a large PDF into smaller documents – every N pages or by page ranges you type.
steps: Select the PDF you want to split.
Choose 'Every N pages' or type ranges such as 1-3, 4, 5-10.
Click Split PDF and download the ZIP of parts.
faq: How do I pull out just a few pages?
Use Extract pages to pick pages visually and save them as one new PDF.

tools.name: Remove pages
tools.title: Delete pages from PDF – Remove PDF pages free online
tools.description: Click the pages you don't need and download the PDF without them. Free, private, no sign-up.
tools.intro: Remove blank, duplicate or unwanted pages from a PDF by clicking them.
steps: Click each page you want to remove.
Click Remove pages and download the result.

tools.name: Extract pages
tools.title: Extract pages from PDF – Save selected pages as a new PDF
tools.description: Pick the pages you want and save them as a new PDF, or as separate files. Free and private.
tools.intro: Copy selected pages out of a PDF into a new document, or one file per page.
steps: Click the pages you want to keep.

tools.name: Organize pages
tools.title: Organize PDF pages – Reorder, rotate and delete pages online
tools.description: Drag PDF pages into a new order, rotate or delete them, and add more files. Free, no sign-up, files stay on your device.
tools.intro: Rearrange pages visually: drag to reorder, rotate sideways scans, delete extras and insert pages from other files.
steps: Select one or more PDFs or images.
Drag pages into order; hover a page to rotate or delete it.

tools.name: Rotate PDF
tools.title: Rotate PDF – Turn PDF pages and save them permanently
tools.description: Rotate single pages or the whole PDF by 90° and save it. Free, private, works on phones too.
tools.intro: Fix sideways or upside-down pages. Click a page to rotate it, or rotate every page at once.
steps: Click pages to rotate them clockwise, or use Rotate all.

tools.name: Crop PDF
tools.title: Crop PDF – Trim PDF margins online, free
tools.description: Crop PDF pages by dragging a box or trim white margins automatically. Free and private – nothing is uploaded.
tools.intro: Cut away margins or keep only part of each page. Detect margins automatically, or drag the crop box yourself.
steps: Drag the crop box, or click Detect margins.
Choose which pages to crop and click Crop PDF.
faq: Can each page be trimmed differently?
Yes – choose 'Trim white margins on each page separately'.

tools.name: Pages per sheet
tools.title: Pages per sheet (N-up) – Print 2, 4 or more PDF pages on one page
tools.description: Put 2, 4, 6, 9 or 16 PDF pages on each sheet to save paper when printing. Free, private, in your browser.
tools.intro: Make handouts and save paper: arrange several pages on each sheet of A4 or Letter.
steps: Select your PDF (or several for batch processing).
Choose how many pages per sheet and the sheet size.

tools.name: Compress PDF
tools.title: Compress PDF – Reduce PDF file size free, without uploading
tools.description: Make PDFs smaller by shrinking large images while keeping text sharp. Batch-compress many files at once. Free and private.
tools.intro: Shrink PDFs for email and uploads. Photos and scans are resized and recompressed; text and vector graphics stay crisp.
faq: Will text get blurry?
No. Only images are recompressed; text stays vector and searchable.
Why did my file not get smaller?
Some PDFs are already well optimized – then the original is kept.

tools.name: Grayscale PDF
tools.title: Grayscale PDF – Convert a color PDF to black and white
tools.description: Turn color PDF pages into grayscale for printing. Text stays searchable. Free, private, batch-capable.
tools.intro: Convert colorful pages to shades of gray – handy for printing and saving toner.

tools.name: OCR PDF
tools.title: OCR PDF – Make scanned PDFs searchable, free and private
tools.description: Recognize text in scanned PDFs and photos in 19 languages, on your device. Get a searchable, copyable PDF.
tools.intro: Turn scans and photos into searchable PDFs. Text recognition runs locally in your browser.
steps: Select a scanned PDF or photos.
faq: Are my scans sent to a server?
No. The recognition engine downloads once and then runs on your device.

tools.name: Images to PDF
tools.title: JPG to PDF – Convert images to PDF free, online
tools.description: Turn JPG, PNG, WebP and other images into a PDF. Choose A4, Letter or image size, orientation and margins.
tools.intro: Convert photos, screenshots and scans into a single PDF, one image per page.
steps: Drag them into order and choose page size and margins.

tools.name: Excel to PDF
tools.title: Excel to PDF – Convert XLSX, XLS and CSV to PDF free
tools.description: Convert spreadsheets to PDF with every sheet included, header rows repeated and wide sheets fitted. No upload.
tools.intro: Turn .xlsx, .xls, .csv and .ods spreadsheets into tidy, searchable PDF pages.
steps: Choose orientation and whether to repeat the header row.
faq: Are charts and cell colors kept?
Values, merged cells and column widths are kept; charts and cell colors are not included.

tools.name: Word to PDF
tools.title: Word to PDF – Convert DOCX to PDF free, in your browser
tools.description: Convert Word documents (.docx) to PDF with searchable text. Free, private – the file never leaves your device.
tools.intro: Convert .docx documents to PDF right in your browser.
faq: Why do some fonts look different?
Fonts that aren't installed on your device are replaced with similar ones.

tools.name: PDF to JPG / PNG
tools.title: PDF to JPG – Convert PDF pages to images free
tools.description: Save every PDF page as a JPG or PNG image at screen, standard or print quality. Free and private.
tools.intro: Export PDF pages as images for slides, websites or sharing.
steps: Choose JPG or PNG and the quality.

tools.name: PDF to Word
tools.title: PDF to Word – Convert PDF to editable DOCX free
tools.description: Turn PDFs into editable Word documents with headings, bold/italic, tables and paragraphs. OCR for scans. No upload.
tools.intro: Convert a PDF into an editable .docx document. Scanned pages can be recognized with OCR first.
steps: Leave OCR on for scanned documents.

tools.name: PDF to Text
tools.title: PDF to Text – Extract text from PDF free
tools.description: Extract all the text from a PDF into a plain .txt file, with OCR for scanned pages. Free and private.
tools.intro: Pull the text out of a PDF – including scans, with OCR.

tools.name: Compare PDF
tools.title: Compare PDF – Find differences between two PDF files
tools.description: Compare two versions of a PDF: changed areas are outlined and added or removed words listed, page by page. Private.
tools.intro: See exactly what changed between two versions of a contract, report or form.
steps: Add the original PDF, then the changed version.

tools.name: Edit PDF properties
tools.title: Edit PDF metadata – Change title, author and keywords
tools.description: Change a PDF's title, author, subject and keywords, or strip hidden metadata before sharing. Free and private.
tools.intro: Edit document properties or remove hidden information such as software names and dates.
steps: Edit the fields, or tick Remove everything else.

tools.name: Edit PDF
tools.title: Edit PDF – Free online PDF editor, no upload
tools.description: Edit existing text, add text, images, shapes, signatures and comments, fill forms and more. Free, runs in your browser.
tools.intro: A full PDF editor in your browser: change existing text, annotate, sign, fill forms and rearrange pages.
steps: Pick a tool from the toolbar and edit.
faq: Can I change text that's already in the PDF?
Yes – use Edit text and click a line. When possible the PDF's own font is reused.

tools.name: Sign PDF
tools.title: Sign PDF – Add your signature to a PDF free
tools.description: Draw or type your signature and place it on any PDF. Saved signatures stay on your device. Free, no account.
tools.intro: Sign documents in seconds: draw with mouse or finger, or type your name in a handwriting font.
steps: Place it, resize it and download.
faq: Is this a digital certificate signature?
It's a visual signature image, which is accepted in many everyday cases. It isn't a cryptographic certificate signature.

tools.name: Fill PDF forms
tools.title: Fill PDF forms online – Free PDF form filler
tools.description: Type into PDF form fields, tick boxes and choose options, then keep it fillable or flatten it. Free and private.
tools.intro: Complete fillable PDF forms in your browser. For forms without fields, type anywhere with the Text tool.
steps: Click fields to fill them in.

tools.name: Annotate PDF
tools.title: Annotate PDF – Highlight, draw and comment on PDFs
tools.description: Highlight text, draw, add shapes, arrows, stamps and sticky-note comments to a PDF. Free, no upload.
tools.intro: Mark up documents for review with highlights, drawings, shapes, stamps and comments.
steps: Choose Highlight, Draw, Shapes, Comment or Stamp.

tools.name: Add page numbers
tools.title: Add page numbers to PDF – Free, with headers and footers
tools.description: Number PDF pages in any position and format, and add headers or footers with the date or file name. Free and private.
tools.intro: Add page numbers like 'Page 1 of 9', plus optional headers and footers.
steps: Choose position, format and start number.

tools.name: Add watermark
tools.title: Watermark PDF – Add a text watermark to PDF free
tools.description: Stamp text such as CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT across every page, with your choice of size, color and opacity. No upload.
tools.intro: Add a diagonal or straight text watermark to every page.
steps: Type the watermark text and adjust it.

tools.name: Redact PDF
tools.title: Redact PDF – Permanently black out sensitive information
tools.description: Black out names, numbers and other sensitive text so it's truly removed from the file, not just covered. Free and private.
tools.intro: Redact information securely: redacted pages are flattened so the hidden text can't be copied or recovered.
steps: Drag over what to remove, or use Find → Redact all.
Download – the content is removed for good.
faq: Is the text really gone?
Yes. Pages with redactions are rebuilt as images, and only the text that's still visible is kept searchable.

tools.name: Protect PDF
tools.title: Protect PDF – Add a password to a PDF free
tools.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password and choose whether people can print, copy or edit it. Runs in your browser.
tools.intro: Lock a PDF with a password before sharing it.
steps: Type a password twice and choose permissions.
faq: Can you recover a lost password?
No. The password is never stored anywhere, so keep it safe.

tools.name: Unlock PDF
tools.title: Unlock PDF – Remove a PDF password you know
tools.description: Remove the password and printing or copying restrictions from a PDF you have the password for. Free and private.
tools.intro: Save an unrestricted copy of a protected PDF, using its password.
faq: Can it open a PDF without the password?
No. You need to know the password to open it.

commonFaq: No. PDF Worker runs entirely in your browser – your files are processed on your own device and never sent to a server.
Yes. There's no account, no watermark and no daily limit.
Does it work on my phone?
Yes, in any modern mobile browser, and there's also an Android app.
